cohort: The study participants were women who underwent fistula closure at the Hamlin Fistula Center in Addis Ababa, central Ethiopia, between February 10, 2018, and December 28, 2020.
finding: Age at repair (14-19 years), rural residence, height <150 cm, labor duration longer than 2 days, delivery by cesarean section, damaged urethra, fistula diameter >3 cm, previous fistula attempts, and vaginal scar were identified as factors related to failed fistula closure, while completion of ANC was associated with a lower risk of failure.
mod_finding: Delivery by cesarean section was identified as a factor contributing to failed fistula closure.
